title: Every Animal More Dangerous Than It Looks to Doug (Marathon)
card: FIVE ANIMALS, ALL WORSE THAN THEIR REPUTATION
intro: Doug has met a hyena, a bison, a walrus, an ant swarm and a chimpanzee. Each one has a harmless reputation. Each one has killed more than its reputation suggests. He is about to learn this five times in a row.
description: Five full episodes back to back: why hyenas beat lions, every reason the bison is Yellowstone's most dangerous animal, how the walrus kills without biting, why army ants overwhelm what can't run, and why chimpanzees kill their own relatives. Real science, cartoon deaths.
